itinerary_data.trip_summary: A personalized 3-day solo journey across Paris, curated with a focus on Historical places, Food and Fine Dining dining experiences.

days.day_title: Arrival, City Center Orientation & Welcome Flavors
days.summary: Enjoy a thoughtfully curated day exploring Paris's highlights, matching your Balanced pace and Fine Dining taste.

morning.title: Eiffel Tower & Champ de Mars
morning.description: Ascend the iconic Iron Lady and relax with a picnic on the expansive lawns below.
morning.travel_tip: Book summit elevator tickets exactly 60 days early.

afternoon.title: Louvre Museum & Tuileries Garden
afternoon.description: Admire the Mona Lisa, Winged Victory, and Venus de Milo before strolling royal palace gardens.
afternoon.travel_tip: Enter via the Carrousel du Louvre underground mall entrance for shorter lines.

evening.title: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur Basilica
evening.description: Wander romantic cobblestone alleys, artist squares, and witness panoramic sunset views over Paris.
evening.travel_tip: Watch out for wristband hawkers around the bottom steps; take the funicular.

meals.description: Cozy breakfast spot famous for freshly baked breads and local morning delicacies.
Popular spot curated specifically for Fine Dining lovers with rave local reviews.
Atmospheric dinner setting serving farm-to-table seasonal specials and house wines.

days.day_title: Iconic Landmarks, Ancient Heritage & Scenic Lookouts
days.summary: Enjoy a thoughtfully curated day exploring Paris's highlights, matching your Balanced pace and Fine Dining taste.

morning.title: Musée d'Orsay Impressionist Masterpieces
morning.description: Marvel at Monet, Van Gogh, and Degas housed in a magnificent Beaux-Arts railway station.
morning.travel_tip: Stand behind the giant railway clock face on the top floor for an iconic silhouette photo.

afternoon.title: Seine River Twilight Cruise
afternoon.description: Glide past illuminated Gothic cathedrals and golden bridges aboard a scenic river boat.
afternoon.travel_tip: Hop on a boat that departs 30 minutes before dusk to catch golden hour & evening illumination.

evening.title: Le Marais Historic District & Bakeries
evening.description: Explore medieval architecture, boutique fashion, artisan falafel, and top French patisseries.
evening.travel_tip: Stop at L'As du Fallafel for lunch; the line moves very fast.

meals.description: Cozy breakfast spot famous for freshly baked breads and local morning delicacies.
Popular spot curated specifically for Fine Dining lovers with rave local reviews.
Atmospheric dinner setting serving farm-to-table seasonal specials and house wines.

accommodation_options.name: Paris Boutique Oasis & Suites
accommodation_options.booking_advice: Book at least 3 weeks prior to secure complimentary city-view upgrades.

accommodation_options.name: The Grand Heritage Hotel Paris
accommodation_options.booking_advice: Request an upper-floor room away from street noise for the ultimate tranquil stay.

accommodation_options.name: Urban Traveler Eco-Lodge & Pods
accommodation_options.booking_advice: Great cost-saving option for travelers prioritizing sightseeing over room size.

transportation_options.description: The most efficient way to navigate Paris. Reliable, frequent, and air-conditioned trains connecting all major attractions.
transportation_options.average_cost: 15 - 25 EUR for a multi-day unlimited pass
transportation_options.pro_tip: Download the local transit mobile app to view real-time arrival countdowns and digital ticket scanning.

transportation_options.description: Paris's core districts feature dedicated cycling lanes and scenic pedestrian avenues perfect for exploring at your own pace.
transportation_options.average_cost: 5 - 10 EUR per hour or daily bike rental
transportation_options.pro_tip: Look for docked city bikes around public squares; check brake pads and tire pressure before unlocking.

transportation_options.description: Convenient for late evening returns or traveling with heavy luggage between airport/train station and your accommodation.
transportation_options.pro_tip: Always verify that the driver starts the official meter or book through authorized apps to prevent overcharging.

travel_tips.weather_summary: Pleasant seasonal temperatures expected in Paris. Mild breezes during evenings with sunny daytime conditions.
recommended_clothing: Breathable moisture-wicking layers for daytime walking
Light jacket or cardigan for cooler evenings
Comfortable broken-in walking shoes or supportive sneakers
Modest attire (covering shoulders and knees) for religious and cultural sites
cultural_etiquette: Gaze respect when entering shrines, temples, or historic places of worship.
Tipping customs: Check your bill before leaving gratuity, as service charges are often included.
Always ask permission before photographing local market vendors or individual residents.
Keep voice volume moderate on public transit and quiet residential lanes.
safety_and_emergency: Keep emergency contacts and embassy address saved offline on your phone.
Store passport and primary backup credit cards in the hotel room safe; carry digital copies.
Beware of unsolicited street petitions or distractions in busy tourist plazas.
Emergency Services Number: Inquire locally (dial 112 in Europe, 911 in North America, 110/119 in Japan).
packing_checklist: Universal travel power adapter with surge protection
Portable power bank (10,000+ mAh) for long sightseeing days
Small compact travel umbrella or lightweight rain poncho
Basic personal medical kit (band-aids, blister pads, pain relievers, allergy medication)
best_apps: Google Translate (with offline camera lens download)
